name: Can I enlarge my garage door opening to fit a larger door?

mainEntity.name: Can I enlarge my garage door opening to fit a larger door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can upgrade your garage door size, but it requires structural framing changes rather than a simple swap. Modifying an opening, such as converting two single doors into a double door or raising the header for a taller vehicle, involves removing drywall, installing an engineered load-bearing header, and adjusting wall studs. Because HH Remodeling specializes in custom framing, finish carpentry, and drywall repair, we handle the structural changes, permits, and wall finishes required before mounting the new door and tracks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it requires structural framing alterations, including installing a wider load-bearing header, reframing the rough opening, and repairing surrounding drywall and trim.
